listing.name: Naruto: The Broken Bond — NarutoBBRecomp (TrinityForever15)
listing.summary: Experimental project. The maintainer’s Windows x64 D3D12 tests reach portions of gameplay. The project explicitly does not describe the game as confirmed playable or complete. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own files under recomp/fase4/assets; default.xex fingerprint is declared in README evidence extract, unmodified supported executable required.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the project’s source-build instructions with its pinned SDK and bootstrap/build_clean_windows.ps1. This guide does not establish a ready-to-run release.

warnings: The maintainer’s Windows x64 D3D12 tests reach portions of gameplay. The project explicitly does not describe the game as confirmed playable or complete.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
